scope: Engineering readiness and a reserved new-image test set; human predictive generalization remains unmeasured

design.ids: HOLDOUT_0001 through HOLDOUT_0016, ordered by content family then style

styles.instruction: Editorial illustration with matte painted textures, simplified shapes and a restrained natural palette. Clearly an illustration, not a photograph.
Naturalistic editorial photograph with realistic materials, gentle daylight and ordinary colours. Clearly photographic, not painted or rendered.

content_families.scene: A small courtyard after rain, with a stone basin, a wooden bench and climbing plants. No people.
A neighborhood market stall with neatly arranged seasonal fruit, woven baskets and a striped awning. No people.
A small craft workshop, with a wooden workbench, hand tools, pieces of timber and a window. No people.
A reading corner beside a window, with an armchair, a closed book, a cup and a floor lamp. No people.
A coastal walking path with a low stone wall, grass, a distant headland and open sea. No people.
A quiet transit waiting area, with three chairs, a small potted plant, a platform edge and a distant train. No people.
A dining table set for a shared meal, with four bowls, vegetables, bread, a water jug and simple chairs. No people.
A small garden with raised planting beds, a watering can, stepping stones and a low fence. No people.

design.matched_pair_instruction: Render each content family once in each style. Keep the described objects, activity and material layout as similar as the generator permits. Record visible deviations rather than interpreting them as psychological attributes.
design.presentation: Individual portrait assets in the test pack; style and content-family identifiers are experimental design labels, not preference targets
design.novelty_claim: New generated depictions from a later batch without old images as inputs; not a claim that the content categories or source model training data are novel
design.human_presence: No people in every design cell; this pack does not test preferences about human subjects
allowed_regeneration_reasons: panel boundaries make a required image unusable
accidental reuse of an original card
prohibited_selection_reasons: human preferences disagree with a candidate
design.source_sheet_policy: One independent generation call per asset. Contact sheets, cropped old cards and augmentations are not substitutes for these new images.

blinding.later_annotation_policy: If required, freeze an independent annotation protocol before collecting test choices. Annotators must not see user choices or model rankings. Do not infer labels from the choices being evaluated.

feature_contract.fit_inputs: Original catalog only; no holdout pixels, annotations, choices or scores
feature_contract.stored_pixel_output: Unscaled eight principal-component coordinates; apply the candidate's declared 0.5 scale once
feature_contract.missing_axes_policy: Unsupported for candidates requiring axes or type labels; never substitute zero coordinates or derive a type from pixels or choices
feature_contract.unknown_motifs_policy: Use only a frozen independently annotated vocabulary and report coverage/unknowns; no fabricated tags or vocabulary expansion on the test set

required: All original source hashes match the protocol before freezing a projection
Projection fit uses exactly the original 256 cards
Frozen transform reproduces the original eight pixel coordinates within 1e-8 maximum absolute error
Every available holdout asset decodes, has a unique ID and byte hash, and yields 64 finite raw descriptors and eight finite projected coordinates
Changing or adding holdout images cannot change the frozen projection or original catalog
Nonfinite values, wrong widths, altered projection hashes and unknown required labels fail explicitly
Original production manifest, catalog identities and historical replay hashes remain unchanged
The pack retains generation provenance and marks human outcomes as not collected

human_evaluation_contract.training_phase: Fit each eligible candidate from the visitor's original-deck choices, then freeze its parameters before any holdout choice
human_evaluation_contract.test_phase: Collect new-deck choices before showing a reading, predicted ranking, explanatory text or model-selected exposure
human_evaluation_contract.exposure: Use the same predeclared heldout options for all candidates; randomize or counterbalance screen positions and record actual visibility/layout

candidate_eligibility.stop_only: Eligible when fitted on original-deck training choices
candidate_eligibility.pixel_only: Eligible with a frozen original-deck pixel feature map and declared dimensions
candidate_eligibility.axes_only: Unsupported until independently annotated axes are frozen
candidate_eligibility.type16: Unsupported until independently annotated types are frozen
candidate_eligibility.hybrid_axes_pixels: Unsupported until independently annotated axes are frozen
candidate_eligibility.motif91: Unsupported until independent annotations and frozen-vocabulary coverage are available

human_evaluation_contract.primary_metric: Heldout per-choice negative log-likelihood including stop, compared with the visitor's training-only stop baseline
human_evaluation_contract.reporting_unit: Visitor; all visits and test choices of a visitor stay together in interval resampling
human_evaluation_contract.claim_gate: No human-generalization claim before the evaluator protocol fixes minimum usable coverage, sample size and interval/comparison rules and the eligible candidate passes them
human_evaluation_contract.integration_owner: The prediction-evaluation workstream owns metrics, candidate fitting and final statistical decision rules; this pack supplies immutable assets and feature/provenance contracts

integrity.write_policy: Freeze this protocol before generation. Later amendments require a new protocol version and a new result identity; preserve v1.
